bull.point: The company demonstrates exceptional cash generation, converting 124% of reported profit into operating cash over the last six years.
bull.evidence: 124% of reported profit turned into operating cash over 6 years

bull.point: Revenue growth is accelerating significantly, with the latest quarter showing a 26% year-on-year increase to ₹53,356 Cr.
Management is targeting massive scale, planning to increase production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.
bull.evidence: plans in place to increase the production capacity to 4 million units per annum

bear.point: Operating margins are under pressure, dropping to 9% in the latest quarter compared to 12% in the previous year.
bear.evidence: Latest-quarter margin 9% vs 12% a year ago

bear.point: Profitability is declining despite higher sales, with Sep 2026 PAT falling to ₹2,466 Cr from ₹3,349 Cr YoY.
Analysts are concerned about rising costs, specifically incremental headwinds from commodity and steel repricing impacting future margins.
bear.evidence: Incremental cost headwinds and commodity/steel repricing impact on margins

watch_next: Recovery of OPM % from current 9% toward historical 13% levels
Impact of brownfield capacity ramp-up costs on quarterly profitability
Achievement of the 10% annual growth target set by the Chairman
